name: Video-MME-v2 (64 frames, no subtitles; 3,088 questions after the train-overlap check)

assignment.task: Official Video-MME-v2 multiple-choice video question answering (no subtitles, no audio). One answer per question.
assignment.observation: 64 uniformly sampled frames of the video in temporal order, then the official question prompt with options A-H.

actions.action: The answer text; the official extractor takes the first capital letter A-H, so answer with the letter only.

assignment.evaluation: Official Video-MME-v2 accuracy and non-linear (group) score.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.

data.note: 400 videos listed in env/videos-to-download.csv (HF MME-Benchmarks/Video-MME-v2 @ 6e4bebb, SHA-256 checked) and their 1,600 questions (configurations.json); 64 frames per video sampled as in the H0 prep
